points.description: The answer conveys that a C++ program starts executing at the main function (equivalent wording, such as 'the main() function' or 'main', earns the mark).

rubric.notes: The model answer is a single idea, so the whole 5 marks go to one all-or-nothing point. Full marks for identifying main as the entry point, in any equivalent wording. No marks if the student names another function or gives no answer.
